Overlapping targets between autophagy and metabolic pathways implicated in ferroptosis in BC

Overlapping targets between autophagy and metabolic pathways implicated in ferroptosis in BC. In the formation of autolysosome, an endless stream of mechanisms are involved. The key regulators, such as PI3K-AKT-mTOR, AMPK, lncRNA, miRNA, GPX4, HO1, DFO and other signaling pathways, which rolling in the progress of metabolic pathways of ferroptosis in BC
